Sol House Mallorca 4* ADULTS ONLY (+16)
O Sol House Mallorca 4* ADULTS ONLY (+16)
The hotel is located 50 m from the sandy beach. The closest cities are Santa Ponsa (7 km), Palma de Mallorca (14 km) and Palmanova (1 km). Accessible from the hotel: Katmandu Park (200 m), Pirates Adventure (500 m), PMI Airport (25 km), Nikki Beach Club (300 m), Wave House Surf (50 m) and disco (50 m). The property is also within easy reach of taxi stands, bus stops, city centre, bars and restaurants and supermarkets.
The resort was built in 1969. Guests are welcomed at the holiday complex, which has a total of 373 rooms. A lobby and a reception are available to travellers. Most of the storeys can be reached by lift. Amenities include a currency exchange service. Wireless internet access (for a fee) is available to guests in the public areas. The complex has a range of facilities for guests with disabilities. Gastronomic options offered by the accommodation include a restaurant and a bar. Additional facilities at the resort include a TV room. Those arriving in their own vehicles can leave them in the car park of the holiday complex for a fee. Additional services include car hire, medical assistance, a wake-up service and a laundry service. Active guests can make use of the bicycle hire service to explore the surrounding area. A business centre with fax machine and photocopier is available.
